nodes.label: transform_modules()
nodes.desc: Rust entry point: parses every input file with SWC and rewrites it into segmented output.

nodes.label: has_qrl_pattern()
nodes.desc: Detects $-suffixed call sites (component$, useTask$, $() ...) that mark lazy boundaries.

nodes.label: EntryStrategy
nodes.desc: Inline, Hoist, Single or Segment decides how extracted handlers split into chunks.

nodes.label: createQRL()
nodes.desc: A QRL is a serializable handle: chunk URL, symbol name, and the captured lexical scope.

nodes.label: qrlToString()
nodes.desc: Encodes a QRL into its wire form chunk#symbol#captureDeltas and registers captures as roots.

nodes.label: SignalImpl
nodes.desc: Getter-based signal: reading .value subscribes the current task to future invalidations.

nodes.label: createStore() Proxy
nodes.desc: Store state is a Proxy whose handler records per-property effects for fine-grained reruns.

nodes.label: renderToStream()
nodes.desc: Server entry: builds an SSRContainer, renders JSX and flushes chunks to the network.

nodes.label: SSRContainer
nodes.desc: Streams HTML out-of-order, backpatches signal bindings and emits qwik/state scripts.

nodes.label: Serializer
nodes.desc: Walks the state graph depth-first and writes the roots array as alternating TypeId/value pairs.

nodes.label: qwikloader
nodes.desc: A few KB of global listeners: events resolve handler QRL attributes and import() the chunk.

nodes.label: inflate()
nodes.desc: Client-side restore: allocate skeletons, then inflate values; cycles resolve through backrefs.
